km_table: the template km_table

Source: R/tpl_docs.R
tfl_tpl_km_table.Rd

The table template km_table, layout km_table. Its program is one call, tfl_tpl(ard, "km_table", ...); a parameter a report leaves out takes the study standard's value, else the variant's default, else the layout's.

Parameters

ParameterTierStageDefaultMaps toWhat
byothercallTRT01Asettings.treatmentthe column variable
by_levelsothercallits values in order; NULL: its code list's
median_labelothercallMedian (95% CI)the median's row
time_prefixothercallDaya rate's row:
time_unitothercalldaysthe times' unit, in the median block's heading
drop_time_0othercallTRUEleave out the rate at time 0

Example

plan <- tfl_tpl(ard, "km_table")

See also

tfl_tpl(), tfl_tpl_help(), tfl_tpl_args(), tfl_templates()

Examples

tfl_tpl_help("km_table", tier = c("required", "usual"))
#> km_table (table, layout km_table; tflspec)
#> Call: tfl_tpl(ard, "km_table", ...)
